name: Cottage Cheese Jellied Salad
description: A light and fruity salad made with cottage cheese, pineapple, and walnuts, set in a gelatin mold.
recipeIngredient: 3 oz package orange or lemon flavored gelatin

recipeInstructions.text: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add mayonnaise and whisk to blend.
Chill until the mixture starts to set.
Add cottage cheese, pineapple, and walnuts. Combine well.
Pour the mixture into a clear glass bowl or a 4-cup lightly oiled mold.

keywords: cottage cheese salad, jellied salad, pineapple salad

_similar.name: Party-Time Salad
_similar.description: A creamy lime Jello salad with pineapple, cream cheese, and celery.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat pineapple juice and hot water to measure 1 cup.
Dissolve Jello powder in hot liquid and stir, then add ¾ cup cold water.
Let partially set.
Add cream cheese and mix with beaters.
Add crushed pineapple, whipped cream, and celery.
Pour into a 1½ quart mould and chill until firm.

_similar.keywords: party-time salad, lime Jello, cream cheese, pineapple

_similar.name: Cranberry Mold
_similar.description: A festive cranberry salad molded with cherry-flavored gelatin, celery, and nuts, perfect as a side dish for turkey.

recipeInstructions.text: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add cold water and chill until the mixture thickens but is not set.
Stir in cranberry sauce, celery, and nuts.
Pour the mixture into a 1½ quart mold and chill until firm.
Unmold before serving.

_similar.keywords: cranberry mold, gelatin salad, holiday side dish

_similar.name: Bacon Broccoli Salad
_similar.description: A hearty broccoli salad with crispy bacon, red onion, and a tangy dressing featuring low-fat yogurt and feta cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the broccoli, red onion, sunflower seeds, raisins, and crumbled bacon in a large salad bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together the yogurt, mayonnaise, sugar, and lemon juice to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad ingredients and toss to coat.
Refrigerate for 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld.

_similar.keywords: broccoli salad, bacon salad, yogurt dressing

_similar.name: Taco Salad
_similar.description: A hearty taco salad with seasoned ground beef, crunchy taco chips, and cheddar cheese, all tossed in Catalina dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook ground beef until crumbly, drain off fat, and season with taco seasoning mix.
Refrigerate the cooked beef until ready to use.
Toss together the cooled beef, chopped lettuce, crushed taco chips, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Mix in Catalina dressing until well coated.
Carefully add in chopped tomato.
Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: taco salad, ground beef, taco chips, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Orange Jello Salad
_similar.description: A simple orange Jello salad with mandarin oranges and Dream Whip.
recipeIngredient: 1 small package Dream Whip (not pudding or instant vanilla)

recipeInstructions.text: Put the first 3 ingredients into a saucepan and cook until clear.
Cool the mixture.
Mix Dream Whip according to package instructions.
Drain oranges and add Dream Whip and oranges to the cooled mixture.
Allow to cool completely before serving.

_similar.keywords: orange Jello salad, mandarin oranges, Dream Whip
